title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 19.Urges the Commission to make full use of the Financial Regulation, notably the EDES, where persons and entities promote Islamist entryism, radicalisation, antisemitism, terrorism, incitement to discrimination, hatred or violence or other activities incompatible with the values of the EU, and to present the measures necessary to strengthen the EU’s capacity to prevent these entities from accessing EU funding; calls on the Commission and other EU bodies to proactively assess and strengthen the verification, whether through ex ante checks or the requirement for binding written commitments, of the compliance with EU values of applicants and beneficiaries of EU funding in order to detect potential breaches;
